title: markermd grading marks
description: Per-repository grading marks for a markermd project: which rubric items are selected for each (repository, question) pair, plus optional public and private comments. Unlike the rubric format this file carries per-student grading state. Rubric items are identified by their description text, copied verbatim from the question's rubric.

name.description: Repository directory name under the project's configured repos directory.
Question name; must exactly match a question name in the project's grading template.

items.description: Descriptions of the rubric items that apply, copied verbatim from the question's rubric. The entry is declarative: listed items are selected, unlisted items are deselected, and [] means no items apply.

comment.description: Public, student-facing comment. An empty string clears the stored comment; omit the field to leave it unchanged.

private_comment.description: Private grader/internal note, never shown to students. An empty string clears it; omit the field to leave it unchanged.
